change_log.value: Integrate the brand audit engine into CI/CD workflows so builds warn or fail on brand violations. Include configurable enforcement levels (warn vs fail) and structured reporting for developer feedback.

stories.title: Define Brand Naming Rules Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a centralized schema that enforces allowed brand terms (e.g., 'ChatHealthy.ai') and disallowed variants (e.g., 'ChatHealthy'). Include configuration for audit scope (files, UI text, APIs) and normalization rules.

stories.title: Implement Brand Audit Core Logic
stories.description: Build a scanning engine that traverses project artifacts (frontend, backend, docs) and detects violations of brand naming rules. Include normalization, pattern matching, and violation reporting.

stories.title: Expose Brand Audit Results via API and Dev UI
stories.description: Provide an internal API endpoint and optional developer-facing UI/report that lists brand violations, file locations, and suggested corrections. Ensure compatibility with existing DevOps workflows.

stories.title: Brand Audit Test Suite and Integration Validation
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating detection of incorrect brand usage across sample artifacts. Include regression tests to ensure no false positives on valid 'ChatHealthy.ai' usage.

stories.title: Integrate Brand Audit into CI/CD Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate the brand audit engine into CI/CD workflows so builds warn or fail on brand violations. Include configurable enforcement levels (warn vs fail) and structured reporting for developer feedback.
